bio.text: Darden Copeland, a Nashville businessman, won the Democratic nomination for Tennessee's 7th Congressional District in the August 2026 primary.
He is the founder and CEO of Calvert Street Group, a Nashville public affairs firm.

According to his campaign website and a Nashville Banner candidate questionnaire, he attended the University of Richmond, worked in Democratic campaigns before leaving electoral politics in 2005, and moved to Nashville in 2008, where he lives with his wife and two children.
